summary: Czech founder-led shop, 30 staff, 2-5 M EUR; our ~EUR 93k is ~2-5 % of its turnover and it says it is reviewing small accounts. Its turning shop went on short-time work (Oct 2026): it needs work. Sole source of adapter piece HI (15.88). Owner prices from a two-year-old spreadsheet and expects partnership for holding prices in 2022. Open moderately, bring sourced index data and the amber scorecard, offer binding volume for its idle shop.
notes: Turning shop on short-time work, so it needs volume more than margin; also wants recognition of the 2022 favour. Its spreadsheet is two years old. Quality amber all year (OTD 73-85 %, ppm ~1,500-1,900, 21 complaints). We pay 5.4 days late on average.
